description: A composite component combining a primary <button> with a dropdown menu trigger. The primary button handles the main action, while the dropdown provides secondary actions via a menu.

keyboard.action: Activates the primary button or the focused menu item
Activates the primary button or the focused menu item
Moves focus to the next menu item
Moves focus to the previous menu item
Moves focus between the primary button and dropdown trigger

focus.notes: Focus ring appears on both the primary button and the dropdown trigger independently. When the menu is open, focus moves into the menu items.

announcements: The primary button label is announced as its accessible name
The dropdown trigger is announced with aria-label "More options"
Menu items are announced by their labels
Destructive items are visually styled but not semantically differentiated

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for all variants)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Ensure the primary button label clearly communicates the default action
For destructive actions in the dropdown, consider adding confirmation dialogs
Disabled state applies to both the primary button and dropdown trigger
